name: Revolved Triangle Pose
description: Straight-legged split stance twisting with one hand down and the other up.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand tall, then step one foot back about a leg's length, back foot turned slightly out.
Square your hips to the front and reach your arms out to the sides.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Revolved Triangle
keyframes.cue: Step back, fold forward, left hand down, right arm up.

cues: Use a block under the lower hand.
